title: Securitization X-Ray
imageAlt: Decorative illustration for the Securitization X-Ray research (artwork, not real data)
fullTitle: Securitization X-Ray: An Evidence-Based Framework for Assessing Stress and Structural Resilience in Indian Securitization Pools
question: Can simple, observable pool indicators warn of stress before it shows up in headline numbers?
data: 19 CRISIL ABS/MBS pool-performance reports (Jun 2019 – Sep 2026), plus RBI and SEBI disclosures.
method: 3 panel-regression models (Baseline → X-Ray → Structural) with transaction fixed effects. Regressions are pending.
integrity: No fabricated data; every number traced to a named source.
